s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of neurological symptoms with evidence of a posterior fossa mass
salient_findings: Mass in the left cerebellomedullary cistern
key_facts: Migraines became more severe and positional over the past year
Neck pain after a motor vehicle accident
Noncontrast CT head showed a mass in the left cerebellomedullary cistern
CT angiography showed displacement of the prepontine vessels without encasement
MRI showed a well-circumscribed mass in the left cerebellomedullary and premedullary cisterns
Mass was hyperintense to CSF on T1- and T2-weighted images
Mass exerted mass effect on the brainstem and cerebellum without surrounding edema

raw.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of neurological symptoms with evidence of a posterior fossa mass
salient_findings: Mass in the left cerebellomedullary cistern
key_facts: Migraines became more severe and positional over the past year
Neck pain after a motor vehicle accident
Noncontrast CT head showed a mass in the left cerebellomedullary cistern
CT angiography showed displacement of the prepontine vessels without encasement
MRI showed a well-circumscribed mass in the left cerebellomedullary and premedullary cisterns
Mass was hyperintense to CSF on T1- and T2-weighted images
Mass exerted mass effect on the brainstem and cerebellum without surrounding edema

shortlist.label: Hemangioblastoma
shortlist.why_kept: Posterior fossa mass with well-circumscribed appearance and hyperintensity on T1- and T2-weighted images

shortlist.label: Meningioma
shortlist.why_kept: Displacement of prepontine vessels without encasement and presence of a well-circumscribed mass

shortlist.label: Schwannoma
shortlist.why_kept: Location in the cerebellomedullary cistern and presence of a well-circumscribed mass

shortlist.label: Epidermoid cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Hyperintensity to CSF on T1- and T2-weighted images and lack of enhancement

shortlist.label: Hemangiopericytoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of a well-circumscribed mass with mass effect on the brainstem and cerebellum

raw.rationale: The mass is well-circumscribed, hyperintense to CSF on T1- and T2-weighted images, and has no enhancement, which are characteristic features of hemangioblastoma. Additionally, the location in the cerebellomedullary cistern and the presence of a focus of susceptibility-related signal loss are also consistent with this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Meningioma
rejected.why: Meningiomas typically show strong enhancement on MRI, which is not seen in this case.

rejected.label: Schwannoma
rejected.why: Schwannomas are usually associated with cranial nerve involvement and would be expected to show more heterogeneous signal intensity on MRI.

rejected.label: Epidermoid cyst
rejected.why: Epidermoid cysts are typically hypointense to CSF on T1-weighted images and do not exert significant mass effect.

rejected.label: Hemangiopericytoma
rejected.why: Hemangiopericytomas are rare and would be expected to show more aggressive features, such as invasion into surrounding structures or heterogeneous enhancement.
